value.summary: The new module adds two pure string-manipulation helpers for truncating model-authored text. Both functions handle multibyte characters safely — `shorten` works in `char` space and its `rfind(' ')` byte index is always at a character boundary since ASCII space cannot be a continuation byte, and `first_sentence`'s `. ` search is likewise byte-safe. No untrusted input reaches a dangerous sink, no network, subprocess, deserialization, or secrets are involved. Safe to merge.
